The '''Rinajaa irstat''' was a [[Tarasin]] [[Irstat|tribe]] that lived in a village deep in the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==History==
The Rinajaa irstat was a tribe of [[Tarasin]] residing deep within the jungles of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] rule. Governed by a tribe [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]], the tribe lived in peace under the guidance of Mother [[Kimania]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Wyrd]]-governed [[Zhadorii irstat]] attacked the Rinajaa and executed several villages in a show of force. When Mother Kimania begged for peace, a Wyrd sister used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to murder the woman and deemed the village under control of the Wyrd. Sometime after the village's occupation a band of mercenaries and freedom fighters known as the [[Heroes of Cularin]] led the [[Cularin Militia]] into the jungles of the world in search of the Wyrd sisters. Together the Heroes were able to topple the Wyrd sisters' control over the irstat and further diminish the groups' numbers.<ref name="HTW" />

Afterward the fighting ended, the survivors placed all the dead inside the huts of the village and then set fire to them in order to cleanse the place of spirits. They then chanted a short prayer to the deceased and disappeared off into the jungle.<ref name="HTW" />
